note: Access Bank Zambia's retail, digital and SME tariff guide (as of 1 June 2025): every savings account carries no monthly maintenance fee; the Standard Savings account asks a 300-kwacha minimum balance and charges for ATM withdrawals beyond two a month, which aren't modelled.

sources.title: Access Bank Zambia, Retail, Digital and SME Banking Tariff Guide (as of 1st June, 2025)
sources.said: RETAIL, DIGITAL AND SME BANKING TARIFF GUIDE - AS OF 1ST JUNE, 2025 ... Standard Savings ZMW 300 ZMW 20 ... *Free monthly maintenance fee on all Savings accounts.
